title: Longman Dictionary of Contemporary English (LDOCE) Grammar & Collocation Guide
evaluation: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ (5/5) — #1 Learner's Dictionary for Collocation & Grammar Patterns

key_pedagogical_pillars.2000_defining_vocabulary: Every word in LDOCE is defined using exclusively the Longman 2,000 Defining Vocabulary, guaranteeing clear, non-circular explanations.
key_pedagogical_pillars.grammar_patterns: LDOCE explicitly labels verb and noun syntactic complementation patterns (e.g. [+ that clause], [+ to do], [+ obj from doing]).
key_pedagogical_pillars.collocation_boxes: Integrated collocation boxes organize pairings into semantic categories (types, actions, modifiers, prepositions).

grammar_patterns_catalog.example: Stricter laws help prevent companies from dumping untreated effluent into rivers.
grammar_patterns_catalog.common_learner_error: Saying *prevent companies to dump* (incorrect infinitival complement).

grammar_patterns_catalog.example: The government is considering introducing carbon taxes on high-emission vehicles.

rules.chance / prospect / risk: Take 'of + -ing': *There is a high risk of developing complications.*
rules.ability / attempt / failure: Take 'to-infinitive': *The failure to regulate financial markets caused panic.*

catalog.example: integral to the functioning of society
